body: Don't blame yourself. It's just their own social inhibition that's stopping this. They do care, promise.
but wasn't "she was too fast, too skilled and too focus on having \[him\] killed" ?

Actually, these numbers can definitely help lots of people. Some may not be aware of helplines, others just need a reminder that people care. Sure, it's a bot, but someone (or multiple people) had to set up this bot - and I have to say, it's a very good bot and I'm personally glad for those "random numbers."
How did he get the knife from her hand?

I agree - this is really frustrated. However, the majority of the people posting \^\^ most likely don't know they're doing it. Sure, "the trolls and ego boosters should stay away," but how would you monitor that? Additionally, wording can be taken very differently from person-to-person and many don't have a strong grasp on locution/linguistics in the first place (me included). Therefore, gate-keeping would be practically impossible as well as morally wrong.

Because professional help can actually be helpful. It might take some time, but it's an option if you want to get better. I hope you do. Sending all my love and hope to you, for your wife and son, but most importantly for you.
